title: PRESSER | Will Echoles - Mississippi State Preview (11-24-26)
text: Will, what what does having that by you mean to you? >> Uh, it means a lot. Bragging rights um for the state and just for me know where I'm from. I told y'all before it's very Mississippi State side. So, this is bragging rights. Knowing this could be your last one inside Ball Hemingway Stadium and it being against Mississippi State, how important is this week in particular for you? >> Uh, it's a very so real moment. You know, I've had I've enjoyed my time here at Old Miss. Um, I'm excited to go out there and play and, you know, just for it to be the Egg Bowl. You know, it could potentially be my last game in the vault. So, I'm super excited to play and ready to go out there and compete. >> I've been asking the other guys about Tom Luke's speech and what that's like to hear. I I take it you probably don't need any extra motivation, but what was it like to to hear him talk about the the meaning of this game? >> Man, I think every year he get like more and more fired up when when he uh when he said it like from my freshman year to now, it's always a about a kid on the playground fighting between Mississippi State and Old Miss and he always talk about how he he went three and one. So, you know, a lot of this for the uh for the state, but you know, most of for Tom Luke, you know, he's a great person. He been around here for a long time. you know, just see just to see him um with a smile on his face after uh after we won last year, you know, just how he carries himself and how much this game means to him. Just want to go out there and play for him. >> When you've been alongside so many other Mississippi guys on the defensive line through these last couple years, what do you see about this week in particular from the rest of the room outside? >> You said what? >> Just like what do you see from the rest of your fellow Mississippians uh during this week? you know, when you're alongside Jam, Perk, and Cam and all that. >> I mean, I mean, they know what this game means. Uh, you know, got a bunch of missive guys in our room especially and some some of them on the offensive side of the ball. So, they know what it mean. They know what it takes to go out there and win this game. They know how physical it's going to be and they know um that it's a big game for, you know, the name on the back of their jersey. >> Hard-hitting question here, but what what's the ideal Thanksgiving plate for you? >> [snorts] >> ideal. Probably some probably some greens, some uh dressing, maybe some ham, something like that. Stuff like that. >> Where's your head at with with playing in the bowl game just knowing the NFL draft board and how how you could be an early pick. >> Um I mean it's still it's still a um I'm just taking it day by day, you know. Uh honestly, um I have I have to talk to PG, talk to him about that. So, uh we just take him day by day, but we'll see. questions. Okay, thanks.
